title: Toll of the Narrow Way
openingText: Thallow lets you see her before she speaks, which in the Crags is a courtesy with a price attached. Two more on the opposite ridge do the same a moment later. 'The pass is two wide and overlooked from three sides,' she says, conversationally. 'I would like us to agree on what that costs before anybody is tired.'
openingTextLate: Thallow lets you see her, as before. Only one shadow answers from the opposite ridge this time. 'The pass is two wide, overlooked from three sides, and lately contested from a fourth I don't put on maps,' she says. 'I would like us to be quick.'
dialogueCordial: Good. I would rather take your coin than your kit off the rocks below.
dialogueStrained: You are haggling on ground you do not hold. I admire it. I am not moved by it.
dialogueHostile: My people are cold and bored and you are raising your voice. Reconsider.
dialogueWalkaway: Then the long way is open to you. It adds two days and passes under four ridges.
dialogueWalkawayLate: Then the long way is open to you. It adds two days, and I no longer vouch for what holds the ridges above it.
dialogueAccept: Agreed. My whistle goes ahead of you to the far end. Nothing will trouble you inside it.

terms.description: Safe conduct the length of the Crags, called ahead ridge by ridge.
Every position with a sightline on the pass, and which are held this season.
Use of the warden caches on the route. Take what you need, replace what you take.
The toll itself, which she has not lowered for anyone in nine years.
Three of those ridge positions are empty and she is bluffing one of them.
terms.rumorText: The ridge lanterns burn in the same pattern every night. Real watches rotate.
